def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    par_value = 1000
    annual_coupon_rate = 0.10
    year_1_spot_rate = 0.06
    year_1_forward_rate = 0.08
    year_2_forward_rate = 0.10

    annual_coupon = par_value * annual_coupon_rate

    # Calculate discount factors from the spot and forward rates
    discount_factor_1 = 1 / (1 + year_1_spot_rate)
    discount_factor_2 = discount_factor_1 / (1 + year_1_forward_rate)
    discount_factor_3 = discount_factor_2 / (1 + year_2_forward_rate)

    # Calculate the bond value using the cash flows at the end of each year
    bond_value = (
        annual_coupon * discount_factor_1
        + annual_coupon * discount_factor_2
        + (annual_coupon + par_value) * discount_factor_3
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_value, 3)
